question: What mass percentage of Cr did ICP find in FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs?
expect: 3.23% by mass (sec. 3.1; its atomic percentage is 21.75%)
trap: Cr's atomic 21.75% or Ni's 3.16% by mass
rendered: According to the document, inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP) was employed to analyze the elemental composition of the FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs sample. The test results showed that the mass percentages of Fe, Co, Ni, Cr, and Mn were 4.86%, 2.59%, 3.16%, 3.23%, and 2.12%, respectively. Therefore, the mass percentage of Cr found by ICP was 3.23%.
